questions.q: A shopkeeper marks an item 10% above cost and gives a 20% discount. What is the overall gain?
The ratio of the speeds of two trains is 7 : 8. If the second train covers 400 km in 4 hours, find the speed of the first.
questions.why: Second = 100 km/h; first = 7/8 × 100 = 87.5. GPSC JSO pre-screening, Jun 2026.

Find the next number in the series: 2, 6, 12, 20, 30, 42, ?
questions.why: The terms are 1x2, 2x3, 3x4 and so on. The next is 7 x 8 = 56.
